svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 04 / TETRIS
svg.desc: 13,951 GitHub contributions across 138 active days, 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-14. Each active week supplies a legal tetromino. Smaller weekly totals fall first; busier weeks accelerate gravity. Pieces collide with the existing stack, completed rows disappear, and the blocks above fall into the gap.
